intro.lead: Provide the credential for this request. Your browser encrypts it before sending it to BlindPass.
intro.step1Body: Match the code with the request you were sent.
intro.step2Body: The page encrypts it for the requester's key.
intro.step3Body: The encrypted payload can be retrieved once before it expires.
intro.boundary: The recipient can decrypt and use this secret. Only share a credential you intend them to have.

card.label: Secret request
card.descriptionHint: Written by the requester. BlindPass doesn't verify it.
card.codeHint: If this code doesn't match your request, close this page.
card.validUntilHint: By the controller's clock; your device clock may differ.
card.minuteLeft: Less than a minute left on this link.
card.addressReminder: Check the page address before entering a credential.

form.singleHelp: Hidden as you type. Show reveals it for 12 seconds.
form.multilineHelp: Multiline values are visible on screen. Line breaks are kept; Windows line endings are sent as LF.
form.multiPlaceholder: Paste a PEM block or JSON credential
form.footnote: Encrypted in your browser. Decrypted by the recipient.

errors.lineBreaks: Keep multiline on while the value has line breaks, or clear it first.
errors.switchedToMultiline: Switched to multiline so the pasted line breaks are kept.
errors.tooLarge: This value is {{size}}; the limit is {{limit}}. Nothing was sent.
errors.rejected: The controller rejected the encrypted payload, so nothing was stored. Check the value and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then submit again.
errors.encryption: Your browser couldn't encrypt this value. Nothing was sent.
errors.notReceived: A status check shows the controller didn't receive it, so nothing was stored. Enter the secret again to send it.

loading.title: Checking this request
loading.body: Loading the request details and checking that the link is still available.
loading.note: Secret entry stays disabled until the request is ready.

submitting.title: Encrypting & sending
submitting.body: Sending the encrypted payload for this request.
submitting.note: Keep this page open. Only the controller's answer confirms submission.

submitted.title: Your part is done.
submitted.body: The encrypted secret was submitted. You can close this tab and return to your task.
submitted.bodyConfirmed: The connection dropped, but a status check confirms the controller received the encrypted secret. You can close this tab.
submitted.note: Submitted doesn't mean retrieved. The recipient still needs to collect and decrypt it before it expires.

used.title: Already submitted.
used.body: This request already received an encrypted payload and can't accept another.
used.note: To send a different credential, ask the requester to start a new request. This doesn't confirm retrieval.

expired.title: This link is no longer available.
expired.body: It has expired or its request is finished. Nothing can be submitted through it.
expired.bodyWhileOpen: The link expired while this page was open. Nothing was sent, and the field was cleared.
expired.bodyOnSubmit: The controller no longer accepts submissions for this link. Confirm with the requester whether they still need it.
expired.note: Ask the requester for a new link, then check its confirmation code before entering your secret.

invalid.title: This link is unavailable.
invalid.body: We couldn't open this request. The link may be incomplete or altered.
invalid.bodySubmit: The controller refused this link's permission to submit. Nothing was stored.
invalid.note: Open the complete original link from the requester. If it still fails, ask for a new request.

auth.title: Sign in to continue.
auth.body: This request needs a signed-in session that this page can't provide.
auth.note: Sign in where you usually use BlindPass, then reopen the original link. Don't enter a secret until the request details appear.

error.title: We couldn't reach the controller.
error.body: The request details didn't load, so entry stays disabled.
error.note: Check your connection, then try again. Nothing has been sent.

unknown.title: Submission not confirmed.
unknown.body: The connection was interrupted before the controller answered. Your secret may already have been submitted.
unknown.note: Don't send it again until the outcome is known. Ask the requester whether it arrived.
unknown.bodyChecking: The connection was interrupted before the controller answered. Checking whether it received your secret…
unknown.bodyUnavailable: The status check didn't get an answer either. Your secret may already have been submitted.
unknown.bodyGone: This link is no longer available, so its status can't be checked. Your secret may or may not have been submitted.
unknown.noteGone: Confirm with the requester whether it arrived. Don't assume it failed, and don't send it another way without asking.

state.closeRefused: Your browser kept this tab open. You can close it yourself.

frame.blocked: This page can't be shown inside another site.

noscript: This page needs JavaScript to encrypt your secret before sending it.

intro.lead: Provide the Source this approved operation needs. Your browser encrypts it for the broker on the target node before sending it.
intro.step1Body: Match the purpose, workload and destination with the operation you approved.
intro.step2Body: The page encrypts it for the node's one-use key.
intro.step3Body: The encrypted Source is delivered to the node's broker once, before the offer ends.
intro.boundary: The node's broker can decrypt and use this Source, only for the destination shown. The controller never sees it.

form.footnote: Encrypted in your browser for the node's broker. The controller stores ciphertext only.

footer.detail: One approved operation. One encrypted handoff.

fleet.purposeHint: Written by the workload that asked for it. BlindPass doesn't verify it.
fleet.destinationHint: Verified against the controller's records for this operation. If the destination isn't the one you approved, close this page.

loading.title: Checking this Source request
loading.body: Loading the operation details and verifying the node's encrypted-delivery offer.
loading.note: Entry stays disabled until the offer is verified.

submitting.title: Encrypting & sending
submitting.body: Encrypting the Source for the node's broker and sending the ciphertext.
submitting.note: Keep this page open. Only the controller's answer confirms it was received.

submitted.title: Your part is done.
submitted.body: The controller received the encrypted Source for delivery to the node. You can close this tab.
submitted.bodyConfirmed: The connection dropped, but a re-check shows the controller holds the receipt. You can close this tab.
submitted.note: Received isn't delivered or in use. The node's broker still has to accept it before the offer ends.

used.title: Already submitted.
used.body: A Source was already received for this operation, which can't accept another.
used.bodyConflict: A different encrypted value was already received for this operation, so this one wasn't stored.
used.note: To change it, request a new operation. This doesn't confirm that the broker accepted it.

expired.title: This Source request is no longer available.
expired.body: The offer or the operation ended. Nothing can be submitted through this link.
expired.bodyWhileOpen: The offer ended while this page was open. Nothing was sent, and the field was cleared.
expired.bodyOnSubmit: The controller no longer accepts a Source for this operation. Nothing was stored.
expired.note: Request a new operation, then open its Source link from the console.

invalid.title: This link is unavailable.
invalid.body: We couldn't open this Source request. The link may be incomplete or altered.
invalid.bodyOffer: The node's offer didn't verify against the controller's records, so nothing will be encrypted or sent.
invalid.bodyOrigin: This copy of the page isn't served by the controller, so it can't use the operator session a Source link needs.
invalid.bodySubmit: The controller refused this link. Nothing was stored.
invalid.note: Open the Source link again from the console. If it still fails, request a new operation.

auth.title: Sign in as the named operator.
auth.body: This link works only for the operator who approved the request, signed in to the console.
auth.note: Sign in to the console as that operator, then check again. Don't enter anything until the details appear.

unknown.title: Submission not confirmed.
unknown.body: The connection was interrupted before the controller answered. Your Source may already have been received.
unknown.note: Don't send it again until the outcome is known. Check again, or ask the operator who approved the request.
unknown.bodyChecking: The connection was interrupted before the controller answered. Checking whether it holds a receipt…
unknown.bodyPending: No receipt was found when we checked, so it may not have arrived, or it may still arrive.
unknown.bodyUnavailable: The re-check didn't get an answer either. Your Source may already have been received.
unknown.bodyGone: This link is no longer available, so its status can't be checked. Your Source may or may not have been received.
unknown.noteGone: Don't assume it failed. Check the operation in the console before requesting another.
